privacy_policies.name: Transparent Data-Minimizing Privacy Policy
privacy_policies.policy_text: We collect only your account email and hashed credentials solely to deliver the service. We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal data with third-party advertising networks. In accordance with GDPR and CCPA, you retain full rights to request complete data export and permanent account deletion at any time by emailing privacy@example.com. All backups are purged within 30 days of account closure.
summary_points: Explicit user data deletion rights and 30-day purge cycle

privacy_policies.name: Predatory Data Broker Privacy Policy
privacy_policies.policy_text: By accessing our website, you grant us an irrevocable, perpetual, royalty-free license to collect, process, and monetize your browsing history, GPS location telemetry, device identifiers, and social contacts. We share and sell aggregated and de-anonymized user profiles to commercial data brokers, marketing partners, and credit evaluation agencies. Data deletion requests are subject to discretionary review and user profiles are retained indefinitely in cold storage archives.
summary_points: Extensive invasive tracking (GPS, browsing history, device IDs)
Commercial monetization and sale to data brokers
Indefinite data retention with discretionary deletion requests
